newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp Inc says moving toward a sale.
newsitem.headline: Riscorp Inc says moving toward a sale.

text.p: Riscorp Inc said on Monday that the company's board of directors' Strategic Alternatives Committee and its financial advisor were moving toward a sale or a complete re-capitalization of the company.

The committee, formed in November, and financial advisor Smith Barnney Inc, are "conducting an active process toward achieving a sale or a complete re-capitalization of the company," Riscorp said in a statement.
The announcement came after two Riscorp insurance companies were assigned an inital letter rating of "C" by A.M. Best Co. The rating remains "under review" with negative implications, Riscorp said.
Riscorp specializes in managed care workers' compensation.
